x="0" y="8" width="960" height="28" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="v-bk" value="<b>Backups</b><br>• automated: daily full backup in the<br> backup window + transaction logs<br> every 5 min → point-in-time restore<br> (oldest backup … 5 min ago)<br>• retention 1–35 days (RDS: 0 = off;<br> Aurora: cannot turn off)<br>• manual snapshots: kept until you<br> delete them" style="rounded=1;absoluteArcSize=1;arcSize=16;fillColor=#dae8fc;strokeColor=#6c8ebf;strokeWidth=1.5;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fontSize=11;fontColor=#1a1a1a;fontFamily=Helvetica;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;spacingLeft=6;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="20" y="50" width="300" height="230" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="v-rs" value="<b>Restore and clone</b><br>• any restore creates a NEW DB<br>• RDS MySQL from S3: DB backup file<br> → S3 → new RDS instance<br>• Aurora MySQL from S3: Percona<br> XtraBackup → S3 → new cluster<br>• Aurora clone: copy-on-write, faster<br> than snapshot+restore (staging DB)<br>• stopped DB still pays storage:<br> snapshot + delete to save" style="rounded=1;absoluteArcSize=1;arcSize=16;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;strokeWidth=1.5;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fontSize=11;fontColor=#1a1a1a;fontFamily=Helvetica;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;spacingLeft=6;" → replicas<br> can't be encrypted<br>• encrypt existing DB: snapshot →<br> copy encrypted → restore<br>• in flight: TLS by default<br>• IAM database authentication<br>• security groups · audit logs →<br> CloudWatch Logs" text.tspan: RDS / Aurora backups, security and RDS Proxy
• automated: daily full backup in the
• any restore creates a NEW DB
• RDS MySQL from S3: DB backup file
• at rest: KMS, chosen at launch;
Storage auto scaling: grows when free space < 10%, low for ≥ 5 min, and 6 h since the last change; set a max threshold.
